chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Fadhl, from Hariz, from Fudayl ibn Yasar, who said:

He (peace be upon him) said: The Ziyarah (visitation) of the grave of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and the Ziyarah of the graves of the Martyrs, and the Ziyarah of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him) equals one Hajj with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family).
Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to me from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Hariz, from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for visiting the grave of Imam Husayn?
ai.summary: This hadith from Kamil al-Ziyarat highlights the unique status of Ziyarat al-Husayn by equating it to Hajj with the Prophet, a comparison that underscores the Imam's role as the spiritual successor and guide. In Shia scholarship, this equivalence is often interpreted to mean that visiting Husayn (a.s.) carries the weight of a complete Hajj, emphasizing the centrality of the Ahl al-Bayt in Islamic devotion and the continuity of prophetic authority.
